Have you ever wondered what fairy tale characters do after the storybook closes?
After every adventure, their costumes need care, too. 

That’s where Bespoke AI Laundry combo comes in.
With Bespoke AI’s AI Wash & Dry, that detects fabrics and soil levels to optimize wash and dry performance, every costume is ready for its next chapter. 

The perfect styles of the tale characters were created with the Bespoke AI Laundry Combo.
